other_conditions: Applicant must be a citizen of India.
Applicant should be a 12th Pass/Diploma Holder/Graduate or in the final year of graduation.
Preference is given to candidates with agriculture or related sector qualification.
benefits_summary: Interns receive a stipend of ₹6,000 per month and an internship completion certificate.
documents_required: Passport size photo in JPG/JPEG format (<2 MB)
Letter of recommendation in PDF format (<2 MB)
Mark sheet or Certificate of Qualification in PDF format (<2 MB)
